meta.name: capital-structure-and-covenants
meta.description: Decides how the business is financed and what that financing then requires of it — debt versus equity, weighted average cost of capital as a hurdle rate, how much leverage cash flow can carry, and the financial, affirmative and negative covenants, definitions, test dates and cure rights that come attached. Use this to evaluate a financing option, set an investment hurdle, check whether a planned decision will trip a covenant, or work out what a lender can do when one breaks.

copy.tagline: 判断融资方案是否可行并检验债务契约风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在融资前需要评估资本结构与契约约束
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate financing options and check covenant risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess capital structure and covenants before financing

howto.what: 它会算加权平均资本成本、比较债务与股权、判断现金流能承受多少杠杆，并解析贷款协议中的财务与限制性条款，指出哪些未来决策可能触发违约。
howto.when: 当你想评估融资方案、设定投资门槛，或检查某决策是否会触碰贷款协议的限制时，该技能会启动。

say.text: 算一下这家公司的加权平均资本成本，并建议一个投资门槛。
say.note: 它会把债务和股本按比例混合算出要求回报率。

say.text: 如果下季度我们增加借款，会触碰现有贷款协议的杠杆上限吗？
say.note: 它会模拟未来季度的财务数据，检查是否存在违约风险。

say.text: 如果利息覆盖率没有达标，贷款方有权做什么？
say.note: 它会解释协议中的补救期、宽限期及违约逐步升级的后果。

howto.what_en: Computes blended cost of capital, weighs debt vs equity, checks leverage capacity, and reviews loan covenants—definitions, test dates, cure rights—to flag decisions that could trip them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to evaluate financing options, set an investment hurdle, or check whether a planned decision could breach a loan covenant.

say_en.text: Compute this company's blended cost of capital and propose an investment hurdle.
say_en.note: It combines debt and equity in proportion to get the required return.

say_en.text: Will adding debt next quarter breach the loan's leverage covenant?
say_en.note: It models next quarter's financials and checks for a breach.

say_en.text: What rights does the lender have if we miss the interest coverage test?
say_en.note: It explains cure periods, waivers, and escalating consequences.
